CancelReason.description: S02 §5.2: why a capture ended without an accepted frame.

CaptureReceipt.description: S02 §5.2/§11.5: receipt of one committed capture. No pixels and no absolute path.

byte_size.description: Decimal string: a byte count must not round through a JavaScript number.

relative_path.description: Library-relative canonical path (`assets/...`), never an absolute path.

ErrorCode.description: Fixed public registry. Never expose provider exception strings in `safe_message`.

oneOf.description:
S02 §5.6: capture vocabulary. Every value is produced by the real capture/library
path; none of them is a placeholder for an unimplemented capability.
S02: the bundled codec refused to encode or decode the accepted image.
S02: the pixel buffer handed to the codec was not a usable image.

LibraryAssetChunk.description:
One bounded image transfer chunk. `library.asset.read` carries canonical bytes;
`library.asset.preview` carries a bounded immutable WebP derivative (which may
differ from the canonical). Digest/MIME/size describe that transfer, never a URL.
`data_hex` keeps the frame printable without a base64 dependency.

total_size.description: Decimal string of the complete transfer payload size.

LibraryRecordEntry.description: S02 §10.3: one entry in a library records page; asset paths are library-relative.

LibraryRecordsPage.description: S02 §10.3: one bounded page of committed records; `next_cursor` is opaque.

RequestEnvelope.description: Decoded after the authorized handshake; `params` never carries a trusted context.
